$comment: D-OPT-MEM2REG-FPR-CONDITIONAL-INIT-RODATA-ZERO — a conditionally-initialized `double` local now PROMOTES instead of being de-promoted to memory. The missing incoming becomes undef-as-zero, and a float has no lowerable zero Const (no float-immediate form on a register machine), so the zero is an anonymous read-only MirGlobal reached by GlobalAddr+Load in the ENTRY block — the SAME producer hir_to_mir's float-literal promotion uses. This arm proves the promoted shape BUILDS and RUNS on every target: the entry-block rodata Load is emitted BEFORE the Arg receives (p and q arrive in FPRs), the join is a double-typed Phi, and the result feeds a real FAdd. It does NOT observe the zero's VALUE — g_c is 1 so the undef edge never executes at runtime (executing it would read an uninitialized object under the baseline pipeline, which the runner diff-asserts against). The value/binding/section/literal are pinned at the MIR tier by Mem2Reg.ConditionallyInitializedFloatAllocaPromotesViaRodataZero. ANTI-FOLD: all three inputs are mutable globals. 10.0 + 32.0 = 42.0 -> 42.
